description.en: Captorhinus aguti inspired living reconstruction: whole living environment prop. Nominal 1m asset length follows TECHNICAL CONTRACT; earlier 0.6m brief prose is superseded art setting not biological size. Species skull C.aguti OMNH44816 Fig1 2022; missing premaxilla completed using 2015 Fig2A. Body anchor JLU2026 genus Captorhinus ROMVP88565/88300, NOT species exact. Tail length about trunk length, tip, soft tissue, color, scale detail and pose are artistic; public plate distal tail cropped. Nature subscription and EurekAlert403 remain STOP; no scan reproduction.
